```{r theme }
truesoil_theme <- theme(
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = 3),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", vjust = -1),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "grey90"),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, colour = 'black'),
        legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "grey40"),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12),
        panel.grid = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(l = 5, b = 5, r = 5, t = 5),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        strip.background = element_rect(colour = "grey90", fill ="white"),
        legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        legend.key = element_rect(fill = NA))

# set up colours
col1 <- "#4E6688"
col2 <- "#332D56"
col3 <- "#E3EEB2"
col4 <- "#71C0BB"
 
# color mapping
color_mapping <- function(Treatment) {
  if (grepl("Control", Treatment)) {
    return(col1)  
  } else if (grepl("Roots", Treatment)) {
    return(col2) 
  } else if (grepl("Urine", Treatment)) {
    return(col3)
  } else if (grepl("Both", Treatment)) {
    return(col4)
    }
}


color_mapping_combo <- function(Treatment_combined) {
  if (grepl("C", Treatment_combined)) {
    return(col1)  
  } else if (grepl("U", Treatment_combined)) {
    return(col3)
    }
}

lines_color <- "grey40"


treatments_short <- as_labeller(c("Control" = "C", 
                                  "Roots" = "R",
                                  "Urine" = "U",
                                  "Both" = "U + R",
                                  "Lincoln" = "Canterbury",
                                  "Kumara" = "West Coast",
                                  "Observed" = "Observed",
                                  "Pielou" = "Pielou",
                                  "Shannon" = "Shannon"))

```

```{r}


# Get all .xls files
files <- list.files(path = "C:/Users/bogda/Documents/PhD/TRUESOIL/urine_experiment/FBA_results/tables", pattern = "\\.xls$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read and combine all files
FBA_results <- purrr::map_df(files, function(file) {
  df <- read_excel(file, sheet = 1)
  sample <- gsub("\\.xls$", "", basename(file))
  df$bin_id <- sample
  return(df)
}) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(bin_id, .before = id) %>%
  separate(
    bin_id,
    into = c("seqcoast_id", "bin_id"),
    sep = "_bin\\.",
    remove = FALSE
  ) %>%
  mutate(bin_id = paste0("bin.", bin_id))

FBA_results
#writexl::write_xlsx(FBA_results, path = "C:/Users/bogda/Documents/PhD/TRUESOIL/urine_experiment/FBA_results/tables/combined_master_table.xlsx")

```


```{r}

# calculate uptake
C_uptake_flux <- FBA_results %>%
  filter(uptake > 0, str_detect(formula, "^C\\d+") | str_detect(formula, "^CH")) %>%
  mutate(C_atoms = case_when(
    str_detect(formula, "^CH") ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_extract(formula, "(?<=^C)\\d+"))
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    C_uptake_rate = C_atoms * uptake
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(C_uptake_rate, C_atoms, .before = charge) %>%
  group_by(seqcoast_id, bin_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum(C_uptake_rate))

# calculate secretion
C_secretion_flux <- FBA_results %>%
  filter(uptake < 0, formula == "CO2" | str_detect(formula, "^C\\d+") | str_detect(formula, "^CH"), name != "Biomass [c0]") %>%
  mutate(C_atoms = case_when(
    str_detect(formula, "^CH") ~ 1,
    str_detect(formula, "CO2") ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(str_extract(formula, "(?<=^C)\\d+"))
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    C_secretion_rate = C_atoms * uptake * -1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(C_secretion_rate, C_atoms, .before = charge) %>%
  group_by(seqcoast_id, bin_id) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum(C_secretion_rate))



# combine them and calculate CUE
CUE_results <- C_uptake_flux %>%
  full_join(C_secretion_flux, by = c("seqcoast_id", "bin_id")) %>%
  dplyr::rename("uptake" = "sum(C_uptake_rate)", "secretion" = "sum(C_secretion_rate)") %>%
  mutate(cue = (uptake - secretion)/uptake)

```

```{r later}
diamond_taxa_data$soil_id_taxa <- paste(diamond_taxa_data$soil_id_rep, diamond_taxa_data$bin, diamond_taxa_data$genus, diamond_taxa_data$class, sep = " ")

  left_join(bins_stats, by = c("sample", "bin"))

# check if gene copies correlate with genome stats
cor.test(correlation_check$count, correlation_check$completeness, method = "spearman")
cor.test(correlation_check$count, correlation_check$contamination, method = "spearman")
cor.test(correlation_check$count, correlation_check$N50, method = "spearman")
cor.test(correlation_check$count, correlation_check$size, method = "spearman")
```

```{r}
combined_results$Treatment_combined <- case_when(combined_results$Treatment %in% c("Control", "Roots") ~ "C / R", TRUE ~ "U / U + R")

combined_results_sum <- combined_results %>%
  group_by(Location, Treatment_combined, Time_d) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    across(
      cue,
      list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 
           IQR = ~IQR(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
    mutate(Time_d = factor(Time_d, levels = c("1", "2", "7", "14", "19", "20", "21", "22", "24", "28", "50", "72", "82")))


combined_results_sum$color <- sapply(combined_results_sum$Treatment, color_mapping)
combined_results_sum$Treatment <- factor(combined_results_sum$Treatment, levels = c("Control", "Roots", "Urine", "Both"))


  
CUE_MAGs_plot_L <- ggplot(combined_results_sum %>% filter(Location == "Lincoln"), aes(y = cue_median, x = Time_d, group = Treatment, color = Treatment, shape = Treatment)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3.8, colour = lines_color, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.2, colour = lines_color, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_line(aes(color = color), linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = cue_median - cue_IQR, ymax = cue_median + cue_IQR, color = color), width =.1) +
  scale_color_identity(name = "Treatment", breaks = c(col1, col2, col3, col4), labels = c("C", "R", "U", "U + R"), guide = "legend") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Treatment", values = c(17, 18, 15, 16), labels = c("C", "R", "U", "U + R"), guide = "legend") +
  labs(x = "Time (d)", y = "CUE") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(2)) +
  truesoil_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(l = 10, b = 10, r = 10, t = 10),
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  ggtitle("Lincoln")

CUE_MAGs_plot_L
```
